Agent.tag: The government knows about the things in the dark. You're the one it sends.
Agent.pick: You want to drive the mystery forward and still hold your own in a gunfight. Think Pinkerton meets The X-Files.

Blessed.tag: A higher power works through you. Keep your soul clean and it always will.
Blessed.pick: You like keeping the group alive, having a moral stance that matters, and being the one monsters fear.

Bounty Hunter.tag: Dead or alive. You lean toward dead; the paperwork's easier.
Bounty Hunter.pick: You want to be the cold professional with the rifle, and you enjoy being the posse's hard edge.

Chi Master.tag: Your fists are faster than their trigger fingers.
Chi Master.pick: You want to close distance, dodge bullets, and punch monsters. Kung fu in the Weird West.

Cowgirl.tag: Give you a good horse and open country and there's nothing you can't handle.
Cowgirl.pick: You want a sturdy, flexible character who's never useless and has a horse that matters.

Explorer.tag: Vast parts of the West are still blank on the map. You intend to fill them in.
Explorer.pick: You like being the one who knows things and keeps the group alive between the gunfights, and you don't mind a slower hero.

Gunslinger.tag: Two pistols, one reputation. Both loaded.
Gunslinger.pick: You want to be the iconic Western hero and deal the most bullets per round. Glass cannon with a sense of humor.

Harrowed.tag: You died. Something climbed back into the body with you. You're still arguing over who's driving.
Harrowed.pick: You want to stand in front, soak damage, and play a dark, morally complicated hero. Not for players who want a clean protagonist.

Hexslinger.tag: Doc Holliday taught the West that a bullet can carry a hex. You learned.
Hexslinger.pick: You want to shoot things with magic bullets and be the flashy, cocky one. Gunslinger with a spellbook.

Huckster.tag: Every hex is a hand of poker played against a demon. You usually win.
Huckster.pick: You want to play the clever, risk-taking caster whose magic is literally a gamble.

Mad Scientist.tag: They laughed at you at the academy. They aren't laughing now. They're running.
Mad Scientist.pick: You want to solve problems with inventions, hand your friends gadgets, and roleplay a genius who's slowly coming apart.

Medicine Woman.role: Spirit healer and voice of reason
Medicine Woman.tag: The spirits grant you power to mend and to cloud the senses. Use it well.
Medicine Woman.pick: You want to heal and talk rather than shoot, and you like a hero defined by her principles.

Metal Mage.tag: Call it science if it comforts you. The whispers in the machine know better.
Metal Mage.pick: You want crowd control and explosions and don't mind a hero who has made a deal he doesn't fully understand.

Muckraker.tag: If it isn't in print, it didn't happen. You intend to print all of it.
Muckraker.pick: You want to be the one asking questions and getting the posse into trouble, and you accept that you'll hide behind the Ranger when the shooting starts.

Native Scout.tag: Your people taught you the land. The land is teaching you what's wrong with it.
Native Scout.pick: You want to scout ahead, set up the ambush instead of walking into it, and shoot from cover.

Saloon Gal.tag: A piano player, a couple of hours, and you'll know every secret this town has buried.
Saloon Gal.pick: You want to win scenes with words, run the posse's network of contacts, and be braver than you look.

Sawbones.tag: Nasty splinter. Gonna have to take the whole arm. Just kidding. Mostly.
Sawbones.pick: You want to be the healer without the religion, and you like a character who talks his way through fear.

Shaman.tag: The Hunting Grounds have turned terrible. You fight to mend the veil.
Shaman.pick: You want a caster who stands near the front, buffs the fighters, and burns evil spirits.

Territorial Ranger.tag: Desperadoes, scoundrels, and things most folks don't know exist. You handle all three.
Territorial Ranger.pick: You want to stand in the doorway, take the hits, and have a badge that lets you say 'official business.'

US Marshal.tag: Put down that hogleg and we'll settle this peaceful-like. Otherwise, you'll see how I got this job.
US Marshal.pick: You want to be the reliable leader who always acts first and never breaks, not the flashiest gun in the room.

Vaquero.tag: You've herded cattle across the whole Southwest and seen things you can't explain. You keep riding.
Vaquero.pick: You want to fight well at every range, have a horse that matters, and play the loyal heart of the posse.

Voodooist.tag: You need some hoodoo? You might know a spirit or two.
Voodooist.pick: You want a healer with menace and mystery, and you like your magic flavored by the bayou rather than the pulpit.

Warrior.tag: You charge without fear at your enemies, be they man or beast.
Warrior.pick: You want to be the melee monster who wades into a crowd and comes out the other side.

Witch.tag: You'd be surprised how many problems a little abracadabra solves.
Witch.pick: You want a toolbox of spells, a spirit companion, and a hero with a secret the world wouldn't forgive.
